verdict.rationale: SES receives inbound mail and uses receipt rules to store it in S3, publish it to SNS, or trigger Lambda functions. That supports use cases like support-ticket creation from incoming email. However, a community user reports having to write a Lambda to dissect each email and forward it to their HTTP endpoint, so parsed webhook delivery requires custom glue code. Missing for 10: native parsing into headers/body/attachments, direct webhook/HTTP delivery of parsed payloads, explicit MX-record setup documentation in the evidence.
